seriesTitle: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You

episodes.title: The 2 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really Love You (98 to Go)
episodes.summary: Aijo Rentaro has faced 100 rejections in life, and when he goes to a matchmaking shrine to pray for love, he finds that he will get more than he ever bargained for in high school.

episodes.title: First Kiss
episodes.summary: Hakari and Karane learn that Rentaro hasn't had his first kiss yet. They may both be his girlfriends, but they still want his first kiss for themselves!

episodes.title: The Quiet Princess, the Knight, and the Samurai
episodes.summary: Rentaro has encountered his third soulmate: the shy and smol Yoshimoto Shizuka. How will he get her to open up to him and, more importantly, how will he choose to deal with her?

episodes.title: Just When You Think It's a Hanky-Panky Episode
episodes.summary: Rentaro has a plan to break the ice between Hakari, Karane, and Shizuka, and it involves laughter and Old Maid. But things take a turn for the unexpected.

episodes.title: The Hyper-Efficient Girl
episodes.summary: Rentaro encounters the smartest student in school, Eiai Nano, and it turns out she's a soulmate, too! However, her extreme rationality leads him to question whether they really are meant for each other.

episodes.title: Everyone's Favorite: The Swimsuit Episode
episodes.summary: Rentaro and the girls hit the newly opened water park at Hakari's suggestion, but Karane appears to have come down with a mysterious chill. Will the gang really get to enjoy their day out at the pool?

episodes.title: Saying Hello to the Chemistry Girl
episodes.summary: Rentaro locks eyes with another soulmate: a beautiful girl in the Chemistry Lab. But when he visits the lab the next day, he instead finds a pint-sized bundle of energy who is... obsessed with drugs?

episodes.title: Kiss Zombie Panic
episodes.summary: Under attack from the kiss zombies, can Rentaro and Kusuri figure out a way to turn them back to normal? Or are they doomed to smooch forever?

episodes.title: The Holy War of Love and Soul
episodes.summary: The gang has a day out at a flower park on Hakari's suggestion. Little did they know that she did it for a reason.

episodes.title: Love Mission: Impossible
episodes.summary: The Rentaro Family gears up to raid the Hanazono mansion to get Hakari out.

episodes.title: Even If It Kills Me
episodes.summary: Hahari may have been blinded by love, but Hakari's happiness remains her number one priority. How can Rentaro convince her that his love is real?

episodes.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You (94 to Go)
episodes.summary: How will the gang adjust to the newest girlfriend, and what shenanigans will she bring into play during this sleepover?

episodes.title: Her Name
episodes.summary: Season 2 begins, and the gap between the seasons means the girlfriends are immediately faced with a crisis. Rentaro, meanwhile, happens to run into a very hungry girl...

episodes.title: The Beginning and the End! Food Fight Festival!
episodes.summary: The food fight festival is here, and the Rentaro Family moves out in order to win the special gelato for themselves. Will they be successful?

episodes.title: What Does the Maid See?
episodes.summary: Hakari laments the change in her once dignified mother. Meanwhile, Hahari's maid piques the gang's curiosity.

episodes.title: Super Soaked Maid Party
episodes.summary: Only one way to welcome a maid into the crew: everyone changes into maid outfits and has a shootout!

episodes.title: Most Athletes Are Masochists
episodes.summary: While the girlfriends are forced to work out, Rentaro runs into a girl who punishes herself for other reasons.

episodes.title: A Homerun Promise
episodes.summary: It's time for the big game. Will the Rentaro Family win and ensure the baseball team's survival?

episodes.title: Karaoke Crisis
episodes.summary: The gang goes to karaoke! But how will Shizuka manage?

episodes.title: The Beautiful and the Bold
episodes.summary: Mimimi and Nano face off in a Beauty Search contest to determine who'll be exiled from the Rentaro Family.

episodes.title: The World Hair Only Grows
episodes.summary: With Rentaro still shaved from the beauty search, the gang decide to show solidarity... to disastrous results.

episodes.title: Peekaboy-Meets-Girl
episodes.summary: Kakure Meme is an extremely shy girl who wishes to live life as a no-name background character. Will she succeed?

episodes.title: Tsundere Lost
episodes.summary: Karane becomes increasingly worried at her inability to be sincere and express her feelings. What will she do?

episodes.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You (89 To Go)
episodes.summary: Rentaro has come up with a convoluted plan to get Karane's tsundere back. Will it work out?

episodes.title: My Cousin Girlfriend
episodes.summary: A reporter asks about love at the shopping mall where Rentaro and some of the girls are.

episodes.title: Chiyo's Family Coaching
episodes.summary: Rentaro introduces his new girlfriend to the family as always, but she's shocked by the state of affairs.

episodes.title: The Japanese Teacher Has Blonde Hair
The Rentaro Family Idol Legend
episodes.summary: The Rentaro Family has to take the stage at the school fest as pinch-hitters. Can they really pull this off?

episodes.title: Momiji-chan's Squishy Festival
episodes.summary: Rentaro seeks out a rumored masseuse to help his surely exhausted girlfriends.

episodes.title: Thumbelinano and the Kusurivanian Family
episodes.summary: Nano is nano-fied for a day, and Rentaro is summoned by Kusuri's dad to explain himself.

episodes.title: Kusuri-Senpai's Grandmother
episodes.summary: While visiting Kusuri's home, Rentaro feels the sparks fly with her grandmother! Is this really going to fly?

episodes.title: Hardcore Hot Springs Hopping with a Chance of Heaven
episodes.summary: The Rentaro Family gets a special invite to a new relaxation facility, but the trip is anything but relaxing!

episodes.title: The Rise and Fall of the Proud Girlfriend
